title: The Lost Pup
lines: Jill is a kind child with a wild pup.
In the cold, the pup slips past the gate.
Jill and Dad go to find it.
Dad holds a lamp up as they go.
Jill calls and calls, but no pup runs up.
Then Jill thinks. She gets the pup's dish.
She shakes it, and the pup jumps up.
It was behind an old gate all this time.
Jill told it to hold still.
Most pups run off, but this one did not.
The wild pup is home and is not cold.

questions.listenFor: Behind an old gate. Stated in the story - have them go back and find it themselves.

questions.ask: What did Jill do that made the pup come out?
questions.listenFor: She got the pup's dish and shook it. If they say "she called it," ask "did that work?"

questions.ask: Do you think the pup will slip past the gate again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason tied to the story - it is wild, or it liked being home and warm.
